newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Frantschach buys stake in Russian paper mill SFE.
newsitem.headline: Frantschach buys stake in Russian paper mill SFE.

text.p: The Frantschach group, Austria's largest paper maker, said on Tuesday it would take a 19.4 percent stake in JVC Syktyvkar Forest Enterprise (SFE), representing its first investment in Russia.
No price details were made available.
Located in Komi Republic, 1,000 km (600 miles) northeast of Moscow, SFE produces an annual 300,000 tonnes of pulp and 400,000 tonnes of paper, Frantschach said in a statement.

In the medium term, the mill has a potential of 400,000 tonnes of pulp and 600,000 tonnes of paper a year. SFE's exports are expected to increase to 60 percent from the current 40 percent of total production. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12256
